one_liner.text: A conversational crypto analyst: create an Analyst (stored as a Lens), ask a question, and it researches live CoinMarketCap data in the same conversation.

description.text: A persistent crypto intelligence workspace: users create Agents (UI name for a Lens), give them natural-language market jobs, and leave those jobs running against CoinMarketCap data with a structured Plan → Evidence → Verification → Result log.

problem.text: Someone who can name a crypto-market job in language wants a teammate that stays on it, not a dashboard they have to configure.

solution.text: Interpret a user message into a research task, plan capabilities without calling CoinMarketCap, then execute PLAN → ACT → OBSERVE → VERIFY → REPAIR? → COMPLETE against live CMC tools and return a grounded reply in the same Lens conversation.

users.text: Researchers or operators who can describe a crypto-market job in natural language and want an analyst that investigates, optionally watches a condition, and returns a verified result with evidence.

description.text: A Lens is a user-owned persistent crypto agent with name, purpose, natural-language request, status (draft/active/paused), versions, routines, and runs.

implemented.text: Lens, LensVersion, and LensRun models exist; versions store policy, job, workflow, and tool-permission JSON.

description.text: Web chat router classifies messages into commands or research, compiles jobs from intent, and can preview policy diffs. Shared for web and later Telegram; does not call CMC directly.

implemented.text: ConversationService.handle is used from login-required lens_detail POST; phrase sets cover check now, pause, resume, results, evidence, why, status, keep watching, and capability/help.

description.text: Understanding classifies a crypto-market request as snapshot, compare, watch, watch_plus_workflow, scheduled, news, or edit, and returns structured JSON (symbols, trigger, listing limit). No CMC calls in this layer.

implemented.text: understand_with_llm and Understanding Pydantic models are implemented; HeuristicProvider is the non-LLM fallback path.

description.text: ResearchPlanner maps a ResearchTask (and optional follow-up context) to a CapabilityPlan and ResearchPlan, selecting existing capabilities and tools without calling CoinMarketCap.

implemented.text: Planner inherits blank follow-up fields from context and defaults capabilities such as market, anomaly, reaction, historical, discovery, and regime.

description.text: AgentRuntime wraps LensRuntime and runs PLAN → ACT → OBSERVE → VERIFY → REPAIR? → COMPLETE, persisting plans, tasks, observations, evidence, and verification records.

implemented.text: run_now and trigger_routine create or continue a LensRun, ensure a Job, persist an AgentPlan, and seed chief/market tasks.

description.text: Deterministic engine compares observation metrics to IntelligencePolicy asset conditions (AND/OR), scores candidates, and decides promote/notify including Telegram notify when severity clears the threshold.

implemented.text: evaluate_policy, compare, and fallback_explanation are implemented in apps/intelligence/engine.py.

description.text: CMCAdapter calls CoinMarketCap Pro API for listings, quotes, historical quotes/listings, and related market endpoints, with optional as_of historical mode.

implemented.text: httpx client against https://pro-api.coinmarketcap.com; runtime registers tools for listings, new listings, historical quotes/OHLCV, latest quotes, content/latest, global metrics, fear-and-greed, trending, gainers-losers, categories, price-performance, altcoin-season, and index quotes.

description.text: Authenticated users can create a Lens from intent, open its workspace, activate a routine, pause it, and receive HTMX/JSON/redirect run status.

implemented.text: lens_create, lens_detail, lens_activate, and lens_pause are login_required; activate can return no_job or a news-unavailable flash.
conflicts: News activate path says monitoring is not available yet, while understanding and product docs treat news as a CMC Content Latest job.

description.text: Background worker and beat processes exist so standing watches can run unattended and write later findings into the same conversation.

implemented.text: Procfile and compose define web, worker, and beat; views import monitoring.tasks.run_lens. The 15-minute interval is documented, not shown in the provided source excerpts.

architecture.text: Django monolith (config + apps users, lenses, intelligence, monitoring, events, notifications, cmc). Understanding and ResearchPlanner do not call CMC; AgentRuntime/LensRuntime execute registered CMC tools. Web is gunicorn; worker/beat are Celery; compose adds Postgres, Redis, and nginx. LensVersion stores compiled policy/job/workflow JSON.

stack.text: Django 5.1–<5.3 web app with custom AUTH_USER_MODEL users.User, WhiteNoise, and Django templates under templates/.
Celery worker and beat with django-celery-beat; Redis as broker/backend in compose.
httpx for CMC HTTP; Pydantic for policy/understanding/job models.
djangorestframework is a declared dependency; no DRF view or router appears in the provided excerpts.

dependencies.text: cursor-sdk>=1.0.24 (Dockerfile falls back to installing requirements without this package if the full install fails)

claim.text: Primary market-data integration via CMC_API_KEY and https://pro-api.coinmarketcap.com (listings, quotes, historical, content, global metrics, fear-and-greed, and other registered endpoints).

AgentRuntime imports notify_artifact from apps.notifications.telegram; conversation router is web-first with later Telegram. Git history includes telegram integration. Chat-over-Telegram is not shown as complete in these excerpts.
Settings detect RAILWAY_ENVIRONMENT / RAILWAY_PUBLIC_DOMAIN, tighten DEBUG, extend ALLOWED_HOSTS and CSRF origins, and set forwarded-proto SSL headers.
DATABASE_URL may point at db.<ref>.supabase.co; settings rewrite to an IPv4 pooler host when the direct host has no IPv4.
Django admin is mounted at admin/.
Root urlconf includes apps.users, apps.lenses, apps.events, and apps.notifications URL modules; concrete public paths are not in this pack.
After a conversation result of kind run, views may return JsonResponse {run_id, stage} or an HTMX run_status partial instead of a full redirect.

database.text: Default Django SQLite at db.sqlite3; DATABASE_URL overrides (Postgres in docker-compose). Settings include a Supabase IPv4 pooler rewrite for db.*.supabase.co hosts. Domain models include Lens, LensVersion, LensRun, plus runtime entities referenced by AgentRuntime (Job, Observation, Evidence, Result, Artifact, etc.).

auth.text: Django AuthenticationMiddleware plus AUTH_USER_MODEL users.User. Lens views are login_required and scoped with _owned / _owned_routine (Http404 if not the owner). CSRF trusted origins are configured for local ports and Railway HTTPS hosts.

deployment.text: Docker image runs docker/entrypoint.sh (default web). Compose: Postgres 16, Redis 7, web/worker/beat, nginx on 8080. Procfile: gunicorn on PORT (default 8000), celery worker, celery beat. Railway host/CSRF/proxy settings in Django. Dockerfile can omit cursor-sdk on pip failure.

demo_opportunities.text: Create an analyst, ask how a named coin is doing or which top-N listings moved, and show the in-thread finding plus evidence.
Compile a stated threshold watch (for example a named-asset percent move) then demonstrate check now versus waiting for the trigger.

marketing.text: Voice: direct, specific, Tell → Clarify → Watch → Act → Return. Never claims real-time continuous observation; monitoring is periodic. Never calls itself a demo. Never invents market numbers. Quiet markets and missing data (not treated as zero) are valid outcomes. User-unnamed coins are not filled in as Bitcoin.
